review_method: Opened and visually inspected all 22 fresh original-resolution 2x2 sheets other-01.png through other-22.png using view_image, covering all 88 native 480x854 source PNGs. Inspected Hebrew RTL/English text, glyphs, visible contrast, native bars, dialogs, list/FAB overlap, Settings, archive, backup/restore, widgets, and actual missed-call/changelog captures. Also opened all four bidi-sensitive source PNGs, both missed-call source PNGs, and both changelog-bottom source PNGs individually using view_image. Independently measured every source PNG SHA-256, checked 480x854 dimensions, and matched the fresh sheet manifest plus all available native per-image hashes. Compared every sheet tile pixel-for-pixel with its source PNG. Verified source/tree/run metadata in matrix, call-integration, personalization and followup verification files. This fresh review does not reuse a previous baseline or source2 pixel approval.

source3_bidi_correction.note: The source2 beta.9-0.11.0 inline ordering defect is absent in these four fresh source3 PNGs. Both native glyph-order assertions are true in light and dark.

bounded_findings: Native SystemUI constrains some Hebrew notification-header metadata and the Hebrew speaker-on action label. The new missed-call notifications keep readable caller names, single/multiple titles and Clear; their phone-number suffix is ellipsized.

Contacts/recents show the fixed keypad button overlapping a lower row dial control at the captured scroll offset. Some lower rows are partial above fixed navigation. Long names and date/time metadata are ellipsized. Upper controls, selected shapes, tabs and summaries remain readable; scroll recovery and actual dialing require separate native evidence.
Icon chooser captures show opposite clipped endpoints of the scrollable list. Complementary bottom captures expose the final options; Cancel remains visible.
Some narrow widget previews ellipsize a long contact name or the DA CALLER header. Hebrew initials, other shown names and selected shapes remain legible.
scope_limits: Visual approval covers only these 88 exact fresh PNG byte sequences from source 04e58247399aaa579b7de51c8439fa41653ab98c, app tree 7d00a6eca4d9f5005329d4790d6f8383b48e42a7 and run 41341757982. It does not approve a different tree, workflow run or later publication capture.

Screenshots establish visible presentation. Telecom ownership, missed-notification Clear/Open acknowledgement, actual dialing, return/Back state, data retention and lifecycle behavior require separate native proof.

The six followup captures use actual emulator missed-call notifications and the local changelog Activity at font scale 1.3. Other matrix frames include deliberately configured standard/large-font fixtures and widget previews. Emulator layout previews do not establish arbitrary OEM launcher placement or human document-picker usability.
No physical Jelly Star, SIM/carrier/audio/Bluetooth/proximity/lockscreen behavior, full TalkBack, measured WCAG contrast audit or matching-key data-preserving upgrade is claimed.
